title: The Pain–Comfort Lab: Looking Inside a Language Model
description:
A beginner-friendly, inquiry-based lab for looking inside an AI language model. In eight Colab notebooks, students find a pain-to-comfort direction in Qwen2.5's activations, test it against fair controls, and steer the model's writing, with step-by-step code walk-throughs so no one gets lost. It can't show that a model feels anything.

Text and data: CC BY 4.0. Code: MIT.
notes: Developed with assistance from generative AI tools (Claude, Anthropic) for code drafting, explanation revision, restructuring and testing; all content was reviewed by the author. The Qwen2.5-1.5B model is not included; it is downloaded from Hugging Face under its Apache 2.0 licence.
